justification: Phase 2b surface area is two module-level functions (graph_round_trip_json, run_graph_on_cpu) and two Python classes (Graph, Runtime) created via PyType_FromSpec.  Graph instances wrap a Box<matrix_ir::Graph> inline in the instance struct; Runtime is stateless.  Runtime.run plans + executes a Graph on matrix-runtime + matrix-cpu with caller-supplied bytes inputs and returns a list[bytes] of outputs.  No filesystem, no network, no process spawn, no environment access.  matrix-runtime and matrix-cpu are pure in-process compute over caller-supplied bytes.  All extern "C" Python C API symbols are resolved at runtime by the embedding CPython interpreter; the extension itself opens no resources.  A 4 GiB hard cap on total placed-tensor byte size (MAX_TOTAL_BUFFER_BYTES in exec.rs) prevents adversarial inputs from triggering a process abort via handle_alloc_error.  Type discrimination via PyObject_IsInstance prevents Graph<->Runtime confusion bugs that could otherwise dereference one struct as the other.
